response.overview: Elene is being questioned by a detective and tells him the story of Tornike Eradze, a boy she met online two years ago and with whom she gradually formed a deep connection.  Her story takes us through one mysterious night when Tornike takes Elene away from the city to an abandoned house. Through their conversations, memories, and growing bond, questions slowly begin to emerge about Tornike’s past and his true circumstances.  As the interrogation continues, it becomes clear that not everything is as it first appears. Elene’s memories begin to contradict the facts presented by the investigation, leaving the audience to question where reality ends and imagination begins.
response.tagline: “I think the sky is full of dreams, while the ground is frightening and cold.”
response.title: From ground to the skies
